## Summary

Describe the problem, the chosen solution, and the user-visible result.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results.

## Risk and compatibility

Describe breaking changes, migrations, new network access, credential handling, executable downloads, or OSS/Cloud boundary changes. Write “None” when not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes appropriate tests.
- [ ] TypeScript and Python quality gates pass.
- [ ] User-facing documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private media, transcripts, cookies, logs, or generated output are included.
- [ ] New dependencies and generated lockfile changes were reviewed and audited.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO sign-off (`Signed-off-by:`).
